so we made this t hing called a @framework/skeleton/bones_loader.zig and i wanted to touch base some more on this system and build it out. so here is a bit of a snippet of what i had in mind to spitball your way so check it out. so here is a rough list i threw together 

skeleton for body
head mouth(lips, teeth?) hair eyes(left, right) nose chest shoulder(left, right) upper_arm(left, right) elbow(left, right) lower_arm(left, right) hand(left, right) wrist(left, right) fingers?(left, right) chest breast? abdomen hips(left, right) crotch? butt upper_leg(left, right) knee(left, right) lower_leg(left, right) feet(left, right) toes?(left, right)

skeleton for car
bumper(front, back) door(driver, passenger) hood wheel(front_left, front_right, back_left, back_right) trunk lights(front, back) gas windshield window seat(driver, passenger)

skeleton for props
body[the entire model] pockets?(slot #)[can this thing hold items / is it searchable] placements?[can this thing have items placed ontop of it like a tabletop, where is the table top(s)]

skeleton for items
body[the entire model] grip(left? right?)[where does the player model grab this thing at and with which hand?] ammo?[the place where ammo is reloaded] projectile?[the area it shoots a bullet out of] physical?[the area that makes contact with another model, think slashing with a knife, the blade is the physical]


and here is how i see it working

so here is an example model [Image #21] and il just show you what i mean, so if we just focus on the arm for a moment [Image #22] and look here, i can now select some face, lets do the upper arm [Image #23] alright these are selected and it is all the way through the model right, ok now i can for example, rig this to an upper_arm_left and then i can move down, and find the elbow [Image #24] and we can call that the elbow_left, you see where this is going? and this works the whole way through. ok now what im thinking is, if done correctly, this should let us take arbitrary models and be able to 'quick-rig' them to be interactive like a car, a body, props, items. what do you think
